hints.title: Reorder the work
hints.body: Sort the queries by coordinate and answer them offline.

hints.title: Add eligible intervals
hints.body: As the query coordinate grows, add every interval whose start is at most that coordinate.

hints.title: Remove expired intervals
hints.body: Use a heap ordered by interval length and discard intervals whose end is before the query.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
sort intervals by start
order = query indices sorted by query value
heap = empty
next = 0
for each query index qIndex in order:
    q = queries[qIndex]
    while next < length(intervals) and intervals[next].start <= q:
        push (length, end) onto heap
        next += 1
    while heap is not empty and heap.top.end < q:
        pop heap
    answer[qIndex] = heap.top.length if heap is not empty else -1
return answers
```

This is pseudocode, not a complete solution.
